description: Read a web page or PDF and get its main content as clean, compact Markdown (default) or JSON. Use when a normal fetch returns an empty JavaScript shell, a cookie/consent page, raw PDF bytes, or bloated HTML full of navigation and ads. Renders JavaScript with headless Chromium when needed, accepts consent walls, and strips boilerplate. JSON adds title, author, date, links and tables. News homepages return headline lists, RSS/Atom feeds return items, mode=full returns the whole page. StackOverflow, npm and PyPI are read via their official APIs. Sites that block bots fail fast with a clear error and are not charged. Free: 5 calls/day without an API key. Beyond that: prepaid credits on an API key (buy via POST https://agentreader.xyz/v1/credits/buy?bundle=500 with x402, or by card at https://agentreader.xyz/buy; the key is issued on purchase) or $0.005/call via x402.

extract.description: Returns named fields (title, author, date, price, currency, image, brand, sku, rating, availability, summary…) from JSON-LD, OpenGraph, microdata and meta tags. No LLM. Missing fields are null. In JSON as `fields`, in Markdown as front matter. Default: (none).

format.description: markdown returns the text only. json adds title, author, date, links, tables and metadata. Default: markdown.

mode.description: article: main content only. links: list of headlines with links. full: the whole page, including non-article parts. auto picks article or links based on the page. RSS/Atom feeds always return their items. Default: auto.

render.description: Whether to load the page in headless Chromium. auto does so only when plain fetching returns too little. Default: auto.

url.description: The page, PDF or RSS/Atom feed to read. Also accepted as u or link, without https://, or path style /v1/read/https://….

name: read_url
title: Read URL / web page / PDF to Markdown
